prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot to move the mold from material station to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: material station
What the inspection checks: Check whether the mold is on material station.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A tiered aluminium rack holds two rows of plastic dispensing bottles, photographed at an angle receding to the right. The upper row has seven tall white bottles with red pump dispensers, all fitted and upright; their collars are coloured green, blue, white, red, white, yellow and yellow-white. The lower front row has smaller squeeze bottles with white or clear caps in place, upright, each holding coloured liquid: yellow, dark brown/black, teal-green, black, and pale grey/white further right. Purple-and-white labels with pictograms and Chinese/English text ("Si-Pigment Brown", "Si-Pigment Green", "Si-Pigment Black", "Mold 1") are clipped to the rails. A white sign above reads "Material Storage Area".
observations: The description mentions a label for 'Mold 1', but does not confirm the physical presence of the mold itself on the material station, only dispensing bottles.
